title: Great Barrier Reef dual headlines
subtitle: The same monitoring series can produce ‘record cover’ and ‘largest decline’ without either being a simple lie; unscoped dying and climate-disproof are both UNSUPPORTED
livingFileNotice: This is a Living Evidence File. Cut-off 12/08/2026. Refresh when the next AIMS Long-Term Monitoring Program annual summary is published. Cover is not composition; climate physics is not on trial in this file.

overall.label: Dual headlines from window selection are KNOWN; unscoped terminal dying and record-cover-as-climate-disproof are UNSUPPORTED
overall.confidence: Very high on the cover series and the communication failure; high against the unscoped slogans
overall.summary: There is no single Great Barrier Reef number. AIMS Long-Term Monitoring Program reports northern, central, and southern hard-coral cover separately, against a long-term average, for a stated year. In 2022 AIMS recorded the highest northern (36%) and central (33%) cover in 36 years of monitoring. In 2024/25 the same programme recorded the largest annual regional declines from those high bases: northern 39.8%→30.0% (−24.8%), central 33.2%→28.6% (−13.9%), southern 38.9%→26.9% (−30.6%); northern and central remained above long-term average, southern fell below. Mass bleaching damage is real (2016, 2017, 2020, 2022, 2024 class). Cover is not composition: fast-growing Acropora can inflate cover while diversity lags. Unscoped ‘the Reef is dying’ is not a testable claim. ‘Record cover disproves climate threat’ is UNSUPPORTED. Climate physics is out of this file’s scope. This file scores communication and measurement windows, not a culture-war verdict on the Reef.

claims.claim: The Great Barrier Reef is not one number. AIMS reports northern, central, and southern regions separately. Hard-coral cover, bleaching mortality, composition, and cyclone/COTS impacts are different metrics. A claim that does not specify region, metric, baseline, and end year is not yet a claim.
claims.why: Architectural object of the monitoring programme. Blocks both fatalism and recovery-as-proof slogans.

claims.claim: Cover rises and falls. Both can be true in different windows of the same series. 2022 northern/central highs and 2024/25 high-base declines are not competing datasets. They are sequential readings of one Long-Term Monitoring Program.
claims.why: Same lineage, two years. Dual-headline pedagogy sits on this identity.

claims.confidence: Very high as an LTMP-series maximum, not as ‘ever’
claims.claim: AIMS media release 4 August 2022: northern and central GBR recorded their highest hard-coral cover since AIMS began monitoring 36 years earlier. Surveys of 87 representative reefs (August 2021–May 2022): northern average 36% (from 27% in 2021); central 33% (from 26%). Southern decreased 38%→34%. ‘Highest since monitoring began’ is an LTMP-series max, not geological ‘ever,’ and not a climate-threat disproof.
claims.why: Primary AIMS pin. Fast-growing Acropora drove much of the gain — cover ≠ composition residual.

claims.claim: AIMS Annual Summary 2024/25: from 2024 highs, northern cover 39.8% (34.8–44.2% CI) → 30.0% (26.6–33.8%) , relative −24.8% (largest annual decline for the region since monitoring began; 2025 still above long-term average 26.6%). Central 33.2%→28.6% (−13.9%; still above LTA 19.8%). Southern 38.9%→26.9% (−30.6%; below LTA 29.3%). AIMS framing: primarily 2024 mass-bleaching mortality, compounded by cyclones, freshwater, some COTS; some reefs up to ~70% local loss. ‘Largest annual decline’ and ‘still above long-term average’ (N/C) can both be true.
claims.why: Primary annual. Relative decline from a high base is not ‘reef dead.’ Southern below LTA blocks recovery-only.

claims.claim: Mass bleaching damage on the GBR is real. AIMS records multiple mass bleaching events including 2016, 2017, 2020, 2022, and 2024 class. Recovery windows after late-2010s losses produced 2022-class record cover; subsequent heat stress produced 2024/25 high-base losses. Cumulative frequency shortens recovery. This is a disturbance series, not a climate-physics trial in this file.
claims.why: Blocks ‘record cover means the threat was fake.’ Physics of forcing stays out of this file’s claim budget.

claims.claim: The same AIMS series generates opposite headlines by window and baseline selection. ‘Record coral cover’ is true for northern/central 2022 versus LTMP start. ‘Largest decline’ is true as 2024→2025 relative change for northern and southern. Both fail when used as unscoped total stories. Neither requires fabrication. Both require metric · region · baseline · end year.
claims.why: The chapter’s reason for existing. Communication process, not a secret second dataset.

claims.claim: Audit every Reef claim for metric, region, baseline, and end year. Cover is not composition, not diversity, not resilience. Symmetry is not both-sides mush: unscoped terminal dying and unscoped climate-disproof are both under-specified. Recovery does not deny damage. Alarm that erases recovery also fails the protocol.
claims.why: Method of the Live File. Identity-swap test applies.

claims.confidence: High against unscoped dying; very high against climate-disproof-by-cover
claims.claim: Unscoped ‘the Reef is dying’ is not a precise, testable claim. Scoped predictions (region, metric, window) can be tested. ‘Record cover disproves climate threat’ is UNSUPPORTED: bleaching frequency, AIMS’s own disturbance caveats, and 2024/25 high-base losses sit on the same series as the 2022 highs. This file does not score climate attribution physics.
claims.why: Load-bearing negative. Damage episodes are real; terminal unfalsifiable form is not earned.

hypotheses.title: Unscoped terminal dying
hypotheses.text: The Reef is dying, full stop.
hypotheses.test: C8. Recovery windows and N/C 2025 still above LTA.

hypotheses.title: Record cover kills the climate story
hypotheses.text: 2022 highs prove the threat was fake.
hypotheses.test: C5 / C8. Bleaching series and 2024/25 losses.

hypotheses.title: Both unscoped slogans equally true
hypotheses.text: Symmetry means both total stories win.
hypotheses.test: C7. Symmetry is method, not mush.

hypotheses.title: Windows, not rival datasets
hypotheses.text: Opposite headlines from one series by selection.

independence: aims-ltmp: Primary monitoring series (single gold standard for cover).
bleach-series: Disturbance events via same agency, different product page.
inference-gap: Dual-headline method. Not a fifth measurement lineage.
openQuestions: Composition and diversity lag behind cover after Acropora-driven rebounds — residual, not a C3 kill.
Next AIMS annual after the 12/08/2026 cut-off — living-file trigger.
Media clip archive of specific dual headlines is polish, not a ledger hole.
wouldChange: AIMS revising the 2022 or 2024/25 regional percentages would force C3/C4.
A closed composition series showing cover gains with collapsed diversity would raise the cover≠composition residual without erasing C3.
Nothing in climate-attribution physics changes this communication file unless it is smuggled in as a Reef-cover slogan.
A new monitoring programme that contradicted LTMP regional trajectories would force a re-open — none is public at this cut-off.

methodAudit.name: Grammar
methodAudit.note: Cover, composition, bleaching, dying, and climate attribution are separate. ‘The Reef’ as one noun smuggles C1.

methodAudit.name: Logic
methodAudit.note: H-dying rejected as precise. H-fine rejected. H-both-true rejected. Hidden premises blocked: relative decline = dead; LTMP max = ever; recovery = no threat.

methodAudit.name: Rhetoric
methodAudit.note: Stripped: dying Reef; thriving Reef; both-sides. Neutral: windows, percentages, LTA.

methodAudit.name: Reality
methodAudit.note: Discriminators: 2022 N/C highs; 2024/25 table with LTA; Acropora caveat. Control: one monitoring lineage, not rival datasets.

methodAudit.name: Independence
methodAudit.note: Cover series is one lineage (AIMS LTMP). Dual headlines are process failures of selection. Composition literature is residual.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 1 — Both-sides the climate crisis
methodAudit.note: Attack: you launder denial. Response: C5 bleaching KNOWN; C8 climate-disproof UNSUPPORTED. This file is communication, not physics.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 2 — Record cover was greenwashing
methodAudit.note: Attack: AIMS cooked 2022. Response: primary monitoring; misuse is media process (C6).

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 3 — Largest decline = dead
methodAudit.note: Attack: −24.8% ends the story. Response: high base; N/C 2025 still above LTA.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 4 — Cover is useless
methodAudit.note: Attack: drop the metric. Response: incomplete (composition residual) but load-bearing for the headline phenomenon.
